paite: Luah dia na va galkahna gam ua na zuih ding ua, TOUPA na Pathian un noute hon sinsak dia thu ahon piak, thupiak, dan thuseh leh dan hiaite ahi uh.
heading: Thupiak Thupi
english: Now these are the commandments, the statutes, and the ordinances, which Yahweh your God commanded to teach you, that you might do them in the land that you go over to possess;

paite: Huai bel nou leh na tapate uh leh na tupate un TOUPA na Pathian uh laudan na siam ua, na damsung teng ua adan leh athupiak ka hon piak tengteng na zuihna ding uh leh na hong ten sawttheihna ding uh ahi.
english: that you might fear Yahweh your God, to keep all his statutes and his commandments, which I command you—you, your son, and your son’s son, all the days of your life; and that your days may be prolonged.

paite: Huaiziak in Israel mite aw, lamzang a TOUPA, na pi-le-pute uh Pathian in hon kamchiam bang a nawitui leh khuaizu luanna gam a nakpitak a na hong puntheihna ding un, ngaikhia unla, zui ding in pilvang un.
english: Hear therefore, Israel, and observe to do it, that it may be well with you, and that you may increase mightily, as Yahweh, the God of your fathers, has promised to you, in a land flowing with milk and honey.

paite: Israel mite aw, ngaikhia un, TOUPA na Pathian uh kia TOUPA ahi.
english: Hear, Israel: Yahweh is our God. Yahweh is one.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh na lungtang tengteng un, na lungsim tengteng un, na hatna tengteng un na it ding uh ahi.
english: You shall love Yahweh your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your might.

paite: Hiai thu, tuni a ka hon piak na lungtang uah ataam gige ding a;
english: These words, which I command you today, shall be on your heart;

paite: na tate uh phatuamngaitak in na sinsak ding ua, na inn ua na tut lai un, lampi a na pai lai un, na lup lai un leh na thoh chiang bang un na gen ding uh ahi.
english: and you shall teach them diligently to your children, and shall talk of them when you sit in your house, and when you walk by the way, and when you lie down, and when you rise up.

paite: Chiamtehna ding in na ban uah na vial ding ua, na mit kikal uah talgakna ding in a-om ding ahi.
english: You shall bind them for a sign on your hand, and they shall be for frontlets between your eyes.

paite: Na inn kongkhak biang leh na kongkhak uah na gelh ding uhi.
english: You shall write them on the door posts of your house and on your gates.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA na Pathian un na pu uh Abraham, Isak leh Jakob kiang a kichiam a ahon piak gam, na bawlkhiak uh hi het lou,
heading: Thuman Louh Vauhilhna
english: It shall be, when Yahweh your God brings you into the land which he swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give you, great and goodly cities which you didn’t build,

paite: kho thupi leh kilawm taktakte, na hihdim uh hi het lou, thil hoih chiteng a dim innte, na leh uh hi het lou tuikhuk lehsate, na suan uh hi het lou grephuan leh olive singte omna a hon pilut a, na nek ua na tai chiang un, pilvang mahmah un.
english: and houses full of all good things which you didn’t fill, and cisterns dug out which you didn’t dig, vineyards and olive trees which you didn’t plant, and you shall eat and be full;

paite: Huchi lou in zaw Aigupta gam a saltanna inn a pan hon pikhia TOUPA na mangngilh kha mahmah ding uhi.
english: then beware lest you forget Yahweh, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh laudan na siam ding ua, ama nna na sem ding ua, amin lou in na kichiam ding uh ahi.
english: You shall fear Yahweh your God; and you shall serve him, and shall swear by his name.

paite: pathian dangte na zui ding uh ahi kei, na kim ua mite pathiante na be ding uh ahi kei.
english: You shall not go after other gods, of the gods of the peoples who are around you,

paite: Na lak ua TOUPA na Pathian uh zaw Pathian mullit hat ahi; TOUPA na Pathian uh na tung uah aheh dia, lei a pan hon hihmang kha ding hi.
english: for Yahweh your God among you is a jealous God, lest the anger of Yahweh your God be kindled against you, and he destroy you from off the face of the earth.

paite: Massah a na ze-et bang un TOUPA na Pathian uh na ze-et ding uh ahi kei.
english: You shall not tempt Yahweh your God, as you tempted him in Massah.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un ahon piak, athupiakte, athu theihsakte leh adante pilvangtak in na zui ding uh.
english: You shall diligently keep the commandments of Yahweh your God, and his testimonies, and his statutes, which he has commanded you.

paite: TOUPA mitmuh a dik leh hoih na hih ding uh ahi. Huchi in nou a ding in ahoih dia, TOUPA'N na pi-le-pute uh kiang a, achiam gam hoih a lut in, na luah thei ding uhi.
english: You shall do that which is right and good in Yahweh’s sight, that it may be well with you and that you may go in and possess the good land which Yahweh swore to your fathers,

paite: TOUPA'N agensa bang in, na ma ua kipan na melma tengteng uh ahawlkhe ding hi.
english: to thrust out all your enemies from before you, as Yahweh has spoken.

paite: Na tate un, "TOUPA i Pathian un thu hon piak, athu theihsaknate, dante, dan thusehte, bangchidan ahia?" chi a tunung lam chiang a ahon dot chiang un,
english: When your son asks you in time to come, saying, “What do the testimonies, the statutes, and the ordinances, which Yahweh our God has commanded you mean?”

paite: nou na tate uh kiang ah, "Aigupta gam ah Pharaoh sikha i na hi ua, TOUPA'N Aigupta gam a pan khut hattak in hon pikhia hi.
english: then you shall tell your son, “We were Pharaoh’s slaves in Egypt. Yahweh brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand;

paite: TOUPA'N i mitmuh un Aigupta gam tung ah, Pharaoh tung ah, a-inkuanpih tengteng tung ah, chiamtehna leh thillamdang, thupi leh huaise mahmahte amusak hi.
english: and Yahweh showed great and awesome signs and wonders on Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his house, before our eyes;

paite: Eite bel hon pe dia i pi-le-pute kiang a piak ding chi a akichiam gam hon piaktheihna ding in huai gam a pan hon pikhia hi.
english: and he brought us out from there, that he might bring us in, to give us the land which he swore to our fathers.

paite: Huchi in hiai dan tengteng zui ding leh i hoih tawntungna dia TOUPA i Pathian laudan siam ding in TOUPA'N thu hon pia a, tuni a mihing a hon hawitheihna ding in.
english: Yahweh commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear Yahweh our God, for our good always, that he might preserve us alive, as we are today.

paite: Athu hon piak bang a TOUPA ma a thupiak tengteng zui dia i pilvanleh ei a ding in damna ahi ding," na chi ding uhi.
english: It shall be righteousness to us, if we observe to do all these commandments before Yahweh our God, as he has commanded us.”
